**# Instructions for Accurately Documenting Reportable Workplace Accidents**

**Important Note:**  "Reportable" accidents vary by jurisdiction (OSHA in the US, HSE in the UK, WSIB in Canada, etc.). *Know your local reporting requirements* (timeframes, injury/illness types) *before* you begin. This guide assumes any accident potentially meeting those criteria.
